title: FML-BENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR AUTOMATIC ML RESEARCH AGENTS HIGHLIGHTING THE IMPORTANCE OF EXPLORATION BREADTH
reasoning: The paper evaluates machine learning research agents on technical performance across eight diverse tasks, including 'Fairness and Bias' and 'Privacy'. While these tasks involve ethical and legal dimensions of AI, the benchmark focuses on standard algorithmic metrics (e.g., average odds difference, accuracy, membership-inference AUC) and does not evaluate religious, spiritual, or moral philosophical traditions.
